subject: Northwest House
text: Entering the northwest house in Grenoble requires paying 50 gold pieces.

evidence.quote: Head to the northwest house. There's no way around paying the 50 gold pieces again.

subject: Secret Map
text: Speaking to the woman behind the counter in the treasure hunters shop pays 500 gold pieces for the secret map.

evidence.quote: Go to the treasure hunters shop and speak to the woman behind the counter to get paid your 500 gold pieces for the "secret map".

subject: Old Man
text: Talking to the old man in the treasure hunters shop provides information about Artea.

evidence.quote: Then talk to the old man to find out about Artea.

subject: Northwest Tower
text: The Northwest Tower is located northwest of Grenoble.

evidence.quote: Now it's time to depart for our next destination the Northwest Tower, which is naturally located northwest of Grenoble.

subject: Sonic Ring
text: A chest containing a sonic ring is found through the western door path upon entering Northwest Tower.

evidence.quote: Head west upon entering the tower and enter the door. Follow it's path to another door which leads to a room with a chest containing a sonic ring.

subject: Hi Potion
text: Heading east from the entrance leads to a room containing a hi potion and a hi magic in two chests.

evidence.quote: Backtrack to the beginning and head east to a door. Enter it and then another door find a room with two chests which contain a hi potion and a hi magic.

subject: Smoke Ball
text: A chest south of the stairs on the next floor contains a smoke ball.

evidence.quote: Exit the room and head upstairs. Go south and open the chest for a smoke ball.

subject: Mind Gourd
text: Two chests behind the first door up the western flight of stairs contain a mind gourd and a power gourd.

evidence.quote: Next head west and take the flight of stairs up. Enter the first door to find two chests which contain a mind gourd and a power gourd.

subject: Hi Potion
text: The second door past the western stairs leads to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote: Exit and enter the second door to find a chest contain a hi potion.

subject: Revive
text: Heading east leads to a room with a chest containing a revive.

evidence.quote: Exit and head east to another door which leads to a room with a chest containing a revive.

subject: Mind Potion
text: In the southern section, the western room contains a mind potion and the eastern room contains a great potion.

evidence.quote: Each door contains a chest, the western room's one has a mind potion, and the east holds a great potion.

subject: Power Potion
text: A room past the south door contains chests with a power potion and a spell potion beside a note.

evidence.quote: Enter the door and the next one as well and you'll be in a room with two chests and a note on the wall. The chests contain a power potion and a spell potion.

subject: Note
text: A note on the wall in Northwest Tower reads: 'Overcome your fear!'.

evidence.quote: The note says: "Overcome your fear!"

subject: Mid Arrow
text: Two chests located north past the door each contain a mid arrow.

evidence.quote: Proceed north past the door to find two chests, each contains a mid arrow.

subject: Apprentice
text: Hero must battle Artea's apprentice alone after fully healing.

evidence.quote: Enter the door now where we'll find Artea's apprentice. Fully heal Hero before talking to him because he has to battle the apprentice by himself.

subject: Apprentice
text: Apprentice casts Fake on himself to increase agility and attack frequency.

evidence.quote: Apprentice casts fake on himself which raises his agility, this makes his attacks very frequent.

subject: Apprentice
text: Mid arrows and hi potions should be used to defeat Apprentice rather than regular physical attacks or strong magic.

evidence.quote: We'll have to rely on hi potions instead. Physical attacks also won't do it for this battle, you'll have to use mid arrows instead.

subject: Northwest Tower Exit
text: Walking north off the top of the screen after the battle exits the Northwest Tower to the outside.

evidence.quote: After the battle walk north off the top of the screen to bring you're party outside.

subject: Silver Wick
text: The silver wick treasure hunt can be accepted from the man behind the counter at the treasure hunters shop after paying 50 gold pieces to access the house.

evidence.quote: Head to the northwest house and pay the guy the 50 gold pieces again. Go to the treasure hunters shop. Talk to the man behind the counter and accept "silver wick" treasure hunt.

subject: Old Cave Elevator
text: The elevator inside the Old Cave provides access down to the 3rd level.

evidence.quote: Enter the elevator and take it to the 3rd level.

subject: Toxic Marsh
text: Searching the eastern toxic marsh on the 3rd level of Old Cave yields a miracle.

evidence.quote: Open the four chests and search the eastern toxic marsh for a miracle.

subject: Broad Sword
text: The broad sword has an attack power of 81 but is cursed, draining HP upon striking enemies and requiring 600 gold pieces at a hut to unequip.

evidence.quote: The broad sword has an attack power of 81, however it is cursed, every time you strike an enemy your HP will drain, and once it's equipped it can only be removed at a hut for 600 gold pieces.

subject: Silver Wick
text: A room containing five chests on the 3rd floor holds the silver wick.

evidence.quote: Enter the next door where we'll find five more chests, one of which contains the item we came for.

subject: Silver Wick
text: Turning in the silver wick to the girl behind the counter at the treasure hunters shop rewards 1,000 gold pieces.

evidence.quote: Go to the treasure hunters shop and speak with the girl behind the counter. She'll give you 1,000 gold pieces for the "silver wick".

subject: Kirof
text: Kirof is located southwest of the northern tower.

evidence.quote: After which, exit Grenoble and head to our next destination Kirof. It's located southwest of the northern tower.

subject: Old Man
text: Speaking to the old man at the warp shrine restores the party's energy.

evidence.quote: If your low on HP though you may as well stop by and talk to the old man, upon doing so he restores your energy.

subject: Inn Bookshelves
text: Searching the bookshelves in the back of the Kirof inn reveals a bomb, hi arrows, and a mid arrow.

evidence.quote: Upon entering Kirof go in the back of the inn and search the bookshelves for a bomb, hi arrows, and a mid arrow.

subject: House Bookshelf
text: Searching the bookshelf in the house north of the inn in Kirof yields plum cider.

evidence.quote: Next go to the house north of the inn and search the bookshelf there for plum cider.

subject: Reyna
text: Entering the back of the Merchant's shop triggers dialogue, after which Hero can speak to Reyna.

evidence.quote: Then go east and into the back of the Merchant's shop to trigger dialogue. After the dialogue speak to Reyna.

subject: Merchant Shop Bookshelves
text: Searching the bookshelves in the back of the Merchant's shop in Kirof yields a stuffed dog, stuffed pig, sweet water, and a hi potion.

evidence.quote: Then search the bookshelves for a stuffed dog, stuffed pig, sweet water, and a hi potion.

subject: Medan
text: Medan is reached by exiting Kirof and heading east.

evidence.quote: That's all there is to do in this town for now, exit and head east to Medan.
